details:
Right now if your new to vrchat you would be surprised that it has more than 100 worlds as most of the categories are full of the same worlds, such as spotlight or trending there all the same worlds all the time other than one or two new ones every now and again, tending feels more like the discontinued active categories as if you look at the worlds there more or less sorted by how many people are currently in them.

Other than new, community labs and a very small chance of been in random there is very little visibility for your worlds.

Sure there is search but how can people search for worlds they do not know exist.

Even really good worlds can get missed if they release at the wrong time or on the wrong day and people just miss it.

So how about this, make a new category called weekly trending or Popular this week.  This is an automatic category that sorts all worlds released into new and this is important as some linger in labs for a while,  now make an algorithm that takes total visits and favourites also total time spent in world and by these metrics gives it a score that is used to rank it in the new category,  Sort all the worlds released into new by there score, a world only spends a maximum of seven days in this category meaning if it was undiscovered for say five days and then becomes popular and rushes to number 1 position it will only stay there for another two days,  this is to be fair to new released worlds.

As it is automatic and is not based on how many people are currently in the world as this changes depending on the time of day and what part of the world is awake and active this method is very fair and impartial.

We need something and I feel this is the best of all methods right now.
title: Weekly Trending Catagory
